tools.name: Document Ingest
tools.description: OCR and structured extraction from sub-ledger feeds (AP invoices, AR settlements, payroll accruals, intercompany entries).
tools.f1_metaphor: Sensor data arriving from the car

tools.name: AP/AR Reconciliation
tools.description: Match AP invoices against AR settlements with configurable drift budget. Flag unmatched items as exceptions.
tools.f1_metaphor: Lap delta — within threshold or outlier

tools.name: Exception Triage
tools.description: Classify exceptions by severity (P1/P2/P3), apply SLA targets, route to appropriate review queue.

tools.name: HITL Approval Gate
tools.description: Structured approval gate with multi-level approver chain. Blocks close progress until all required approvals received.
tools.f1_metaphor: Pit stop — the pit wall must sign off

tools.name: Audit Trail Logger
tools.description: Immutable append-only log of every action, approval, and system event. sha256-hashed entries for tamper detection.
tools.f1_metaphor: Race telemetry — every data point recorded

tools.name: Evidence Binder
tools.description: Compile all approved items, audit entries, and assertions into a signed evidence PDF with sha256 manifest.
tools.f1_metaphor: Court pack ready for the stewards

tools.name: Airia Blueprint Builder
tools.description: Map close workflow tasks to Airia template steps. Export as community bundle or deploy directly to platform.
tools.f1_metaphor: Race strategy compiled into race-day plan

tools.name: Race Control Dashboard
tools.description: Real-time close-progress monitor showing lap completion, active incidents, pending pit stops, and team status.
